summary: Badge gains variant="info" (--ui-intent-info-bg fill, --ui-intent-info-fg ink, transparent hairline), so Badge's statuses are exactly Banner's five intents (#9). The same pair Banner info paints: 4.82:1 light, 5.64:1 dark. Distinct from `selected`, which is also blue: selected is a choice (accent fill), info a status (tint).
